newsitem.title: CHINA: China says six of its 29 airlines profitable.
newsitem.headline: China says six of its 29 airlines profitable.

text.p: Only six of China's 29 airlines are profitable, a senior aviation official said.
Shen Yuankang, vice-minister of the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China, declined to give figures or specify which were making money.
But said in a recent interview that total profits of the six airlines exceeded total losses of those money-losing carriers.
The 23 unprofitable airlines have been left to fend for themselves and do not receive state subsidies, Shen said.
China bans the establishment of new airlines but allows foreigners to buy a maximum stake of 35 percent in existing carriers.
